text:
dan: deploy-bot raised a canary regression for model-runtime v2.7 in US-WEST — error rate +1.8% and p95 latency +220ms. autopilot held the rollout. https://grafana/rollouts/xyz :warning:

deploy-bot: autopilot:hold engaged for rollout/2026-03-24T07:33:19Z reason: error_rate_increase>1% && p95_latency_delta>150ms. Suggested next steps: human review and either targeted rollforward to prior stable variant or manual rollback.

priya: tagging @infra @amanda. Can infra grab the failure samples and check whether it's a model or infra regression?

amanda: quick look: many failures are 5xx with a shared stacktrace pointing at a new inference timeout path. Not seeing obvious OOMs.

priya: if it's a timeout due to slower kernel on a subset, we can temporarily route 30% of traffic from US-WEST to runtime v2.6 (stable) as a quick mitigation. That avoids full rollback.

infra: I can spin the routing change. Command: `routing/slice --service inference --region us-west --from v2.7 --to v2.6 --pct 30` — will do as soon as we confirm.

dan: decision: hold stays. Priya + Amanda to decide within 10m whether to do a 30% regional slice to v2.6. If the slice works, keep hold and draft customer blurb. If not, escalate for full rollback approval.

priya: running sampling now, posting logs to ops link.

amanda: logs posted: https://drive/ops/trace-4585009999 2 sample traces show increased kernel latency on two hosts. Not universal. Recommend slice.

infra: executing routing change in 30s. Will monitor p95 and errors.

(deploy updates)

infra: routing applied: us-west 30% -> v2.6. deploy-bot: rollout update detected.

deploy-bot: note: observed p95 drop in us-west slice from +220ms to +30ms; error rate back to baseline on routed slice.

priya: good. posting a short customer-facing note: "We temporarily routed a portion of US-West traffic to a stable runtime to restore performance while we investigate. We'll follow up with a root-cause update."

release-lead: keep the hold until we have a postmortem. Good job on the targeted slice. We'll schedule a re-release trial after kernel fix.

dan: closing for now; leave hold open until PM posts RCA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
